interrupted_reason: Fourth reap this session, on this run after it exceeded its own 600s foreground window and was auto-backgrounded (confirming: the reaper targets background shells specifically, and a command becomes vulnerable again once moved to background even if it started in the foreground and survived there). stdout.log shows 94%+ complete, every dot a pass, no F before the cut. Not restarted, per the harness's instruction. Superseded by full-suite CI evidence on push, which this local spot-check was never load-bearing for.
